An '''electrum sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond sword]] with [[electrum alloy]]. It is built for fighting undead, with [[Warding]] 3, Smite III and Looting II.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|7}} damage at an attack speed of 1.9, matching the [[diamond sword]]'s damage at a faster swing. It has 3000 durability.

=== Intrinsics ===
Warding 3 is the highest warding on any weapon. Held warding adds up across both hands to a maximum of 3; level 4 comes only from the full electrum armor set. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into an [[adamant alloy]], not electrum, because electrum shares the netherite item IDs. This makes melting electrum gear a way to turn an [[electrum alloy]] into an adamant alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_sword.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.03|Electrum alloy now needs a [[divine fragment]].}}
{{History line|1.10|Electrum was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal item in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Can only be repaired with blocks of diamond.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|No longer burns in fire or lava. Warding from held items now stacks with other held warding items. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
